2608.04670.title: Easy to Complete, Hard to Choose: Investigating LLM Performance on the ProverbIT Benchmark
2608.04670.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed computational linguistics and achieved remarkable performance across numerous natural language processing tasks, yet significant gaps persist in understanding how these systems process culturally embedded linguistic expressions. This paper introduces ProverbIT, a novel Italian benchmark comprising 100 multiple-choice questions designed to evaluate LLMs' ability to complete Italian proverbs. We assess 13 frontier models, including Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) and traditional LLMs, across three tasks: proverb completion, multiple-choice selection with correct answers, and multiple-choice selection without correct answers. Our evaluation reveals surprising results: while nearly all models demonstrate knowledge of the proverbs through successful completion tasks, performance drops dramatically when transitioning to multiple-choice formats without correct answers, with even state-of-the-art reasoning models showing substantial degradation. Through detailed Chain-of-Thought analysis of two LRMs, we uncover that models exhibit a strong bias toward selecting literal synonyms and frequently mention correct proverb endings during reasoning without successfully identifying their absence from the given options. These findings suggest that current LLMs rely heavily on memorized patterns rather than deeper semantic understanding of culturally grounded expressions, highlighting important limitations in their reasoning capabilities for figurative language comprehension.
2608.04670.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）已經改變了計算語言學，並在許多自然語言處理任務中取得了顯著的表現，然而在理解這些系統如何處理文化嵌入的語言表達方面仍然存在重大差距。本文介紹了 ProverbIT，一個新穎的意大利基準，包含 100 道多選題，旨在評估 LLMs 完成意大利諺語的能力。我們評估了 13 個前沿模型，包括大型推理模型（LRMs）和傳統 LLMs，涵蓋三個任務：諺語完成、帶有正確答案的多選選擇，以及不帶正確答案的多選選擇。我們的評估揭示了驚人的結果：儘管幾乎所有模型在成功完成任務中表現出對諺語的知識，但在轉向不帶正確答案的多選格式時，性能驟降，甚至最先進的推理模型也顯示出顯著的退化。通過對兩個 LRM 的詳細思維鏈分析，我們發現模型在選擇字面同義詞時表現出強烈的偏見，並在推理過程中經常提到正確的諺語結尾，但未能成功識別它們在給定選項中的缺失。這些發現表明，當前的 LLMs 在很大程度上依賴於記憶的模式，而不是對文化根植表達的更深層語義理解，突顯了它們在比喻語言理解方面推理能力的重要限制。
